messages:
alyssa_cs: Heads-up — PetraAI (account: petra-smb) just asked for a short-term EU egress allowlist + temporary rate-limit increase for an investor demo tomorrow 08:00 UTC. They want a burst window ~2M tokens/day for 48h. Can we enable a time-limited exception?

jamal_netops: Do they have static IPs/CIDR? We need exact ranges to add to the peering ACLs. Also need security sign-off for any exceptions.

alyssa_cs: They provided this: ```198.51.100.0/26\n203.0.113.17/32``` They asked for auto-revoke after 72h (demo + 24h buffer).

securitybot: automated-scan: IP ranges checked — no matches to known threat lists. Geo: EU allowed. Flagging for manual sec review because of rate-lift.

jamal_netops: Ok. I can provision peering in eu-west-1 and add those CIDRs. Suggested limits: soft cap 1.2M tokens/day, burst hard cap 3M tokens/day, window 48h. Will include auto-revoke timestamp in ACL entries.

dmitri_eng: Heads-up — if their demo uses long-history chat, prefer pinning to a quantized variant to keep latency/cost predictable. Recommend runtime config: model=redwood-mini-q4_0; fallback=redwood-1.1 (if quality issues, we can bump).

kai_sre: I'll add observability: create dashboard for petra-smb demo, set 95th-p50/95 latency alerts (alert if 95th > 500ms) and token-rate anomaly alerts. Canary rollout 10% for first 30min then full.

samantha_cs: Capture for renewal: demo is with investor panel next week — high impact. I'll mark the account as "at-risk/opportunity" and follow up with a post-demo enablement session.

alyssa_cs: Two asks: (1) Jamal — can you confirm ETA for ACL and rate change? (2) Security — please approve retention of audit logs for 90d for this account during the window.

jamal_netops: Creating NET-5922 with details now. ETA ~2h for peering ACL + rate config if no infra blockers. Will add auto-revoke timestamp and note the soft/hard caps.

securitybot: Manual approval: sec-team@redwood approved temporary exception. Conditions: IPs pinned to ACL, auto-revoke enforced, audit logs enabled (90d), no elevated data access requested.

alyssa_cs: Perfect — I'll notify the customer of approved window and remind them to rotate any demo keys afterwards. Please ping here when NET-5922 is complete. :thumbsup:

jamal_netops: NET-5922 created, ETA 2h, I'll post completion here and include the revocation timestamp. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

dmitri_eng: If we see model quality regressions during the demo, tag me and I can flip fallback within minutes.

kai_sre: Monitoring hooks in place; will watch infra and page if error rates spike. :eyes:
